title: strobilanthes orthostachya

This plant is known for its unique, red-and-yellow flowers that resemble a firecracker, hence its common name. Strobilanthes orthostachya is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
